description: The HTTP surface: the /api/classes route module (CRUD courses/subjects/sections; enroll/unenroll; assign/reassign/substitute faculty with history; create/publish/revise/cancel timetable + scheduled classes with conflict validation; dry-run /check), the own-scoped student + faculty 'my schedule' reads, server.ts registration, and the route-integration (mocked Prisma) + real-DB behavioral test suites. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema/permissions/Zod) and FEAT-002 (pure services it calls). Independent of FEAT-004.
steps: Read context.json + design.md §3 (foundational placement, NO requireModuleActive), §4 (routes), §7/§7.1 (permissions + HOD relation-filter scope), §8.3 (route behavior, 409 envelope, /check), §9 (audit), §10 (validation mapping) FIRST. Mirror the apps/api/src/routes/students.ts pattern exactly.

Create apps/api/src/routes/classes.ts (export classesRoutes), single top-level authenticate preHandler, per-route requirePermission(key), NO requireModuleActive. Handlers: CRUD courses/subjects/sections; enroll (capacity check inside the withTenant tx — A9 soft overshoot, no row lock; duplicate blocked by the DB unique) / unenroll referencing the shared StudentProfile; create faculty profile + assign/reassign/substitute faculty using faculty-assignment.ts (soft transition + FACULTY_REASSIGNED ScheduleRevision in the same tx); create timetable; add/update scheduled class with detectTimetableConflicts (409 + { error, conflicts: ConflictReport } on blocking.length>0, success+warnings envelope otherwise); publish timetable (hard-block 409 on any blocking conflict across slots — A7); cancel scheduled class; revise a published timetable writing a ScheduleRevision row per the §6.9 per-changeType column contract; POST /timetables/:id/check dry-run gated by classes.timetable.manage (NIT-4). Add classesDepartmentScopeFilter(request, kind) relation-filter helper (§7.1) and 404-on-out-of-scope for HOD on reads and writes. Coerce InstitutionConfig.workingDaysOfWeek to a validated number[] (allowance-engine guard shape: Array.isArray -> map(Number) -> filter 0..6 -> fallback [1..6]) before building ConflictContext (NIT-3). Every mutation writes a classes.* AuditEvent via recordAuditEvent(input, tx) in the same withTenant tx.

Add own-scoped read endpoints (permission classes.view_own): in apps/api/src/routes/student.ts a 'my schedule' read (the student's enrolled ClassSection's SCHEDULED classes) and a faculty teaching-schedule read (by the caller's FacultyProfile.id). Serve 'my schedule' via these dedicated own-scoped endpoints, never the staff classes.view catalogue list (A4).
Register classesRoutes in apps/api/src/server.ts at prefix /api/classes (alongside studentAdminRoutes).

Create apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/classes-routes.integration.test.ts (mocked Prisma, academics-routes precedent): permission gating per role (ADMIN manage; HOD manage within scope; FACULTY/STUDENT view_own only, mutate => 403); the 409 conflict envelope on a double-booked slot; the success-plus-warnings envelope on an out-of-hours slot; cross-tenant read => 404; the recordAuditEvent call shape on mutations.

Create apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/classes-behavioral.integration.test.ts (self-contained CLASS_TEST_ prefix, real DB, academics-behavioral precedent): build a small timetable; a double-booked faculty and a double-booked room are rejected (409/blocking); publishing a change writes a schedule_revisions row and UPDATE/DELETE on it is refused (append-only); a faculty reassignment preserves the prior assignment row and writes a FACULTY_REASSIGNED revision; a student and a faculty each read only their own schedule; enrollment references the shared StudentProfile (no second student row). Seeds + tears down its own rows.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` typechecks with classes.ts, the student/faculty reads, and the server.ts registration.
`npm test -w @campusgate/api -- classes-routes` passes: role-gating (403 for FACULTY/STUDENT mutate), 409 conflict envelope, success+warnings envelope, cross-tenant 404, audit call shape.

`npm test -w @campusgate/api -- classes-behavioral` passes: timetable build, double-booked faculty+room rejected, published-change revision written + append-only enforced, faculty reassignment preserves history, student/faculty see only own schedule, enrollment references the shared StudentProfile.
Routes are permission-gated only (no requireModuleActive) and every mutation is tenant-scoped via withTenant and audited.
findings:
COMPLETED. The HTTP surface + own-scoped reads + both test suites are in place; all 3 verification commands green (classes-routes 9 passed; classes-behavioral 5 passed; api build clean). Full turbo build 3/3 workspaces. The full api suite is 353 passed / 6 skipped with only transient Supabase free-tier auto-pause failures (Can't reach database server) in the PRE-EXISTING academics-behavioral + sis real-DB suites — re-running academics-behavioral alone passes 9/9. No regressions from Phase-3 code. Committed locally on main, not pushed.

=== ROUTE PATHS (apps/api/src/routes/classes.ts, registered in server.ts at prefix /api/classes; export classesRoutes) ===
All mutations: single top-level authenticate preHandler + per-route requirePermission(key), NO requireModuleActive (foundational, design §3); all I/O inside withTenant(institutionId from request.user); every mutation writes a classes.* AuditEvent via recordAuditEvent(input, tx) in the SAME tx; HOD 404-on-out-of-scope via classesDepartmentScopeFilter(request, kind) relation-filter (§7.1).
- POST /api/classes/courses (classes.courses.manage) -> 201 course | 400 | 404 program/term | 409 dup code
- PATCH /api/classes/courses/:id (classes.courses.manage)
- GET /api/classes/courses (classes.view) -> { courses }
- GET /api/classes/courses/:id (classes.view) -> course incl. subjects | 404
- POST /api/classes/subjects (classes.courses.manage) -> 201 | 404 course | 409 dup code
- PATCH /api/classes/subjects/:id (classes.courses.manage)
- POST /api/classes/sections (classes.sections.manage) -> 201 | 404 program/session/term | 409 dup (program,session,term,label)
- PATCH /api/classes/sections/:id (classes.sections.manage)
- GET /api/classes/sections (classes.view) -> { sections }
- GET /api/classes/sections/:id (classes.view) -> section incl. enrollments | 404
- POST /api/classes/enroll (classes.enroll) body {classSectionId, studentId} -> 201 enrollment | 404 section/student | 409 duplicate|capacity_full. Resolves the SHARED StudentProfile (studentProfile.findFirst), decideEnrollment() reactivates a prior DROPPED/COMPLETED row (reenroll) — never a 2nd row.
- POST /api/classes/unenroll (classes.enroll) body {classSectionId, studentId} -> drops (status DROPPED) | 404
- POST /api/classes/faculty (classes.faculty.assign) body {userId,name,departmentId?} -> 201 FacultyProfile | 404 user/dept | 409 dup userId
- POST /api/classes/faculty/assign (classes.faculty.assign) body {facultyId,subjectId,academicTermId,classSectionId?,role?,replacesAssignmentId?}. Fresh assign => decideAssign + classes.faculty.assigned audit. With replacesAssignmentId => decideReassignment soft-transition (end current ACTIVE->ENDED+endedAt, insert new ACTIVE, FACULTY_REASSIGNED ScheduleRevision, classes.faculty.substituted audit) all in one tx; prior row RETAINED.
- POST /api/classes/timetables (classes.timetable.manage) -> 201 Timetable (DRAFT) + TIMETABLE_CREATED revision | 404 term
- GET /api/classes/timetables (classes.view) -> { timetables }
- GET /api/classes/timetables/:id (classes.view) -> timetable incl. scheduledClasses | 404
- POST /api/classes/scheduled-classes (classes.timetable.manage) -> builds ConflictContext (term-scoped SCHEDULED slots + CalendarService.effectiveDayType for one-off dates + coerced workingDaysOfWeek) and detectTimetableConflicts. blocking.length>0 => 409 { error:'Timetable conflict', conflicts: ConflictReport } (no write). warnings-only => 201 { scheduledClass, warnings }. On a PUBLISHED timetable also writes SCHEDULED_CLASS_ADDED revision. classes.scheduled_class.added audit.
- PATCH /api/classes/scheduled-classes/:id (classes.timetable.manage) -> same conflict gate (excludes own id); PUBLISHED => SCHEDULED_CLASS_UPDATED revision; classes.scheduled_class.updated audit.
- POST /api/classes/scheduled-classes/:id/cancel (classes.timetable.manage) -> status CANCELLED; PUBLISHED => SCHEDULED_CLASS_CANCELLED revision; classes.scheduled_class.cancelled audit.
- POST /api/classes/timetables/:id/check (classes.timetable.manage, NIT-4 gate) -> DRY-RUN, returns { conflicts: ConflictReport } for the whole timetable, NO write.
- POST /api/classes/timetables/:id/publish (classes.timetable.manage) -> DRAFT->PUBLISHED; re-runs conflict detection across ALL slots, hard-blocks 409 on any blocking (A7); illegal transition (non-DRAFT) => 409; TIMETABLE_PUBLISHED revision + classes.timetable.published audit; -> { timetable, warnings }.
workingDaysOfWeek coerced with the allowance-engine guard shape (Array.isArray -> map(Number) -> filter 0..6 -> fallback [1..6]) before building ConflictContext (NIT-3).

=== OWN-SCOPED READS (apps/api/src/routes/student.ts, prefix /api/student, permission classes.view_own, NO requireModuleActive) ===
- GET /api/student/me/schedule -> { scheduledClasses } : SCHEDULED classes of the student's ENROLLED sections on PUBLISHED timetables; ownership via getStudentInTenant(userId) — never a request id (A4). 404 if no student profile.
- GET /api/student/me/teaching-schedule -> { facultyId, scheduledClasses } : SCHEDULED classes taught by the caller's own FacultyProfile (resolved by userId). 404 if no faculty profile.

=== DEMO-DATA SHAPE for the FEAT-004 smoke test (what the seed must produce / the smoke test exercises) ===
Under the demo institution + ACTIVE 2026-2027 session + Semester 1 term + BCA program + seeded BCA student (BCA2024001):
- Course (code BCA-S1-CORE) -> Subject (CS101 Data Structures, 4 credits).
- ClassSection (BCA + session + Sem1, label A, capacity 60, status ACTIVE).
- ClassEnrollment of the demo student into section A (status ENROLLED) — references the shared StudentProfile.
- A pure-faculty User (role=GUARD per A3) + FacultyProfile (dept BCA) + FacultyAssignment (PRIMARY, CS101, section A, Sem1).
- Timetable (Sem1, PUBLISHED) with a conflict-free ScheduledClass (e.g. Mon/Wed 09:00-10:00 startTime=540 endTime=600, room R-101, CS101, section A, the seeded faculty).
Smoke-test entry points: student reads GET /api/student/me/schedule (sees the CS101 slot); faculty reads GET /api/student/me/teaching-schedule (sees the CS101 slot); admin/HOD GET /api/classes/timetables/:id shows the slot; a 2nd overlapping slot for the same faculty/room is rejected 409.

=== TEST SUITES ADDED ===
- apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/classes-routes.integration.test.ts (mocked @campusgate/db): catalogue check (FACULTY=[classes.view_own] only); ADMIN course create + audit; HOD in-scope create (scope relation-filter asserted); FACULTY/STUDENT mutate => 403; 409 double-booked-faculty envelope (no write); 201 out-of-hours warnings envelope; cross-tenant 404; enroll references shared StudentProfile + audit. 9 tests.
- apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/classes-behavioral.integration.test.ts (self-contained CLASS_TEST_ prefix, real DB via tenant-escape-setup adminClient + withTenant): conflict-free vs double-booked faculty + double-booked room; published-change schedule_revisions row written + UPDATE/DELETE refused (append-only trigger); faculty reassignment preserves prior row (ENDED+endedAt, identity untouched) + FACULTY_REASSIGNED revision; enrollment references the shared StudentProfile (studentProfile count unchanged) + duplicate rejected (decision + DB unique); student reads only own enrolled schedule, faculty reads only own taught schedule. Tears down its own rows (revision trigger disabled in-suite for the scoped delete). 5 tests. NOTE: behavioral suite hits the live DB — transient 'Can't reach database server' = Supabase auto-pause, re-run (it passed 5/5 on retry).
